components.heading: Veritas Social
paragraphs: Veritas Social is a collection of music and culture graphics designed for fast-moving digital channels. Each piece needs to capture an artist, event, or collaboration immediately while remaining part of the larger Veritas identity.
The work combines portrait photography, strong type hierarchy, restrained color, and layered texture to give promotional content an editorial edge.
This page serves as an umbrella case study for the broader visual direction, with individual campaign pages exploring specific executions in more detail.

components.title: Portrait-led promotion with an editorial rhythm.
components.alt: Neeks and Brandt Veritas social graphic
components.caption: A vertical campaign execution balancing artist imagery and concise event information.

components.quote: “Every composition has to communicate before the scroll continues.”
